viewer: Single hourly workers earning $32 an hour full time who could add 8 extra hours of work a week.
decision: Work those 8 hours as overtime at $48 an hour, or at a second job paying $48 an hour?
promise: We run the full federal tax math on both paths, including the new overtime break, and find what a side job must pay to match.
title: Overtime or a Second Job at $48 an Hour: Which Pays More?
